mapper.select: SELECT id, email, name, unique_id, profile_image, introduction, role, warning_count, writing_restricted_until, created_at, updated_at FROM member WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, email, name, unique_id, profile_image, introduction, role, warning_count, writing_restricted_until, created_at, updated_at FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( email, name, unique_id, profile_image, introduction, role ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{name}, #{uniqueId}, #{profileImage}, #{introduction}, #{role} )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, unique_id = #{uniqueId}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, introduction = #{introduction}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.unique_id AS uniqueId, m.name, m.profile_image AS profileImage, m.introduction, m.role,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p WHERE p.member_id = m.id ) AS postCount,
m.follower_count AS followerCount, m.following_count AS followingCount
FROM member m WHERE m.id = #{memberId}

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.unique_id AS uniqueId, m.profile_image AS profileImage, m.introduction, m.follower_count AS followerCount, CASE WHEN f.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS following FROM member m
LEFT JOIN follow f ON f.member_id = #{memberId} AND f.target_id = m.id
WHERE m.id != #{memberId}
-- 내가 팔로우한 사람 제외 AND f.member_id IS NULL
-- 차단 관계 제외 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM block b WHERE (b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.blocked_id = m.id) OR (b.member_id = m.id AND b.blocked_id = #{memberId}) )
ORDER BY m.follower_count DESC, m.id DESC
LIMIT 4
